Prioritised intermediate cities in the Andean countries

Preliminary list of intermediate cities in Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru, identified with the Global Human Settlement Layer and official population data, and refined through expert review. Each city is named after the administrative unit that governs it.

Inti Mesias Barrera · PhD Programme in City, Territory and Sustainable Planning, Universitat Rovira i Virgili (URV) · Supervisor: Dr. Òscar Saladié · Versión en español
